text: Six workers start the night shift at a hotel.
Not all of them are human.
Deaduction. You might be staff, keeping the hotel running and hunting for the imposters.
Or a poltergeist, dropping chandeliers and launching vases.
Or a doppelganger, disguised as one of your co-workers.
The Windows demo is just over six gigabytes, English only.
Worth a dip with friends you don't fully trust.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
